subject: Deployment mode & region mutex for Q4 pilot: proposed MAP and cutover
messages:
From: Emma Cho <emma@acmehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: luke.moreno@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Aligning deployment mode and geo for Q4 pilot

Jonas,

Thanks for the run-through yesterday. We want to lock the deployment approach for the Q4 pilot and make sure there are no surprises in the MAP (mutual action plan). High-level constraints from our side: EU data residency for PII, SOC2 evidence for the pilot scope, and sub-200ms p95 for our most common inference path (50 token prompts).

Primary question: for an initial 6-week pilot with 5k monthly active users, what do you recommend — Hosted (fastest), Dedicated (predictable), or Private (full control)? If we choose Dedicated, what is the minimum lead time for capacity in eu-west-1?

I've attached a short requirements snapshot. Can you propose a MAP with milestones and ownership? Also looping Luke in for infra side.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Cho
Head of Platform, Acme Health
emma@acmehealth.com
Attachment: acme_requirements.pdf (1 page summary)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Cho <emma@acmehealth.com>
Cc: luke.moreno@acmehealth.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-15T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning deployment mode and geo for Q4 pilot

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear constraints. Short answer up front: Hosted for a narrow pilot (2–4 weeks) to validate integration and UX; Dedicated for production if you need predictable throughput and contract SLAs; Private if you require on-prem/VPC isolation and specialized KMS/HSM. Given your EU residency requirement and SOC2 ask, Dedicated in eu-west-1 is the pragmatic middle ground for the pilot-to-prod path.

Proposed MAP (attachment stub: acme_map_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff & onboarding — owners: jonas_weber / emma_cho
- Week 1: Security questionnaire + SOC2 snapshot exchange — owners: naomi_feldman / emma_cho
- Week 2–3: Pilot integration (Hosted sandbox on eu-west-1) — owners: marissa_cole / luke.moreno
- Week 4: Performance validation & cost baseline (p95 < 250ms target) — owners: jonas_weber / acme infra
- Week 5–6: Dedicated capacity reservation + runbook & cutover rehearsal — owners: karthik_iyer / marissa_cole

Lead times: Dedicated reservation for a modest pool (2x A100-equivalent) in eu-west-1 — 3–4 weeks from signed commitment for guaranteed allocation; we can provide a short-term hosted burst while the Dedicated pool is provisioned.

Questions for you:
- Are you able to accept a hosted sandbox for initial integration (we can limit retention and ensure EU routing)?
- Any legal/contract redlines we should preempt (data export, retention windows)?

Dropping the MAP in Drive + DocuSign link for the MSA redlines. I attached the MAP spreadsheet as a working draft.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: acme_map_v1.xlsx (working MAP, milestone owners)

From: Emma Cho <emma@acmehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: luke.moreno@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-16T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning deployment mode and geo for Q4 pilot

Jonas — thanks, that layout helps. We can do a hosted sandbox as long as EU routing and short retention are enforced (we cannot have any PII leave EU jurisdiction). Luke: we will need to validate latency from our EU offices — our expectation is <200ms p95 for the UI flows.

On Dedicated timing: 3–4 weeks is tight but workable if we sign the commitment this week. Two follow-ups:
1) Can you confirm encryption-at-rest key ownership options? We prefer customer-managed keys (KMS) for Dedicated/Private.
2) Can you create a conservative cost estimate for both Hosted vs Dedicated for the pilot (include burst to 10k MAU)?

I've attached our compliance snapshot and a short procurement checklist (redlines_contract_v1.docx will follow with initial comments).

— Emma
Attachment: acme_requirements.pdf, redlines_contract_v1.docx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Cho <emma@acmehealth.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-17T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning deployment mode and geo for Q4 pilot

Emma / Team — looping in a concise operational plan we can include in the MAP. If you opt for Dedicated, here's a minimal canary & cutover approach to keep risk low:

Mutual Action Items (short):
- Legal: Agree MSA redlines (DocuSign link) — owner: Emma / Acme — due: 2026-11-20
- Security: Exchange SOC2 scope & evidence, confirm KMS model (customer-managed available for Dedicated) — owner: naomi_feldman — due: 2026-11-18
- Infra: Provision Dedicated pool (eu-west-1) — owner: karthik_iyer — target commit: 2026-11-22 (ready: ~2026-12-13)
- Integration: Point sandbox to eu-west-1 hosted endpoint, run perf script — owner: marissa_cole / luke.moreno — due: 2026-11-24
- Cutover rehearsal: small canary traffic (~5% of pilot) to Dedicated, rollback plan documented — owner: karthik_iyer / marissa_cole — due: 2026-12-02

Cost ask: I'll get a conservative Hosted vs Dedicated delta for the pilot and include burst assumptions. Note on keys: Dedicated supports customer KMS via our KMS proxy; Private supports HSM if required.

I'll open a short Jira for provisioning and link it in the MAP doc.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Cho <emma@acmehealth.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Aligning deployment mode and geo for Q4 pilot

Thanks all — quick security/governance notes to close the MAP checklist before commit:

- KMS: We can provide customer-managed keys for Dedicated. Please confirm required algorithm and rotation windows. If Acme needs HSM-backed keys, we'll discuss Private options and lead times.
- Dataflow and redaction: Confirm which endpoints will receive raw PII. If any PII is logged, we need to add a redaction contract clause (sample attached to MAP).
- Audit logs: We will provide tenant-scoped audit logs for Dedicated with 90-day retention by default; longer retention tiers are available as an add-on.

Next step: propose we do a short exec sync (30 min) on 2026-11-19 to confirm MSA redlines and provisioning cadence. Jonas — if you can send a calendar invite with the MAP link and DocuSign file, we'll aim to get signatures and procurement kickoff the same week.

— Naomi
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
